FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
From(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:

The departure and arrival cannot be the same airport ::: ∀x ∀y (FliesTo(x, y) ∧ FliesTo(x, z) → y ≠ z).
John flies from LGA airport ::: From(John, LGA).
